## Common questions
- How much does a concrete driveway cost? It depends on size, access and finish — exposed aggregate typically runs $65–$100+ per m². Pridecon quotes firm prices after a site measure, so there are no surprises.
- Do you do exposed aggregate? Yes — it’s one of our specialties. Every photo in the gallery is a real Pridecon pour.
- Are you licensed and insured? Yes — Pridecon Concrete Constructions Pty Ltd (ABN 50 666 436 497) is licensed and fully insured.
- Which areas do you cover? The Central Coast through to Newcastle — if you’re on the marquee below or near it, we can get a crew to you.
- How long before I can drive on new concrete? About 7 days for cars, longer for heavy vehicles. Every pour comes with a cure schedule.
- Do you work for builders? Yes — slabs and structural pours for builders and construction companies, quoted per stage or per project.
